comment: Canary records (SPEC 8, E23). record_json is the record exactly as read from the wire; parse it, then report the verdict at time 'now' with max_age_days. 'rule' names the erratum that decides the case, or is null for behaviour every conforming verifier already has. signature_der_hex, and pubkey_hex (the case's own, else this one), are given to the verifier exactly as written. All signatures use the published test key (private key 0x01 x 32), never a production key.
